explanation: PrepareAssetsForCookingCommandlet.cpp:631-658 enumerates tiles with do { i=0; do { spawn(i,j); if (ok) {save; ++i;} } while (ok); ++j } while (i>0). The inner loop advances only while the previous tile was found and stops at the FIRST miss, so enumeration assumes a tile grid that is contiguous and anchored at (0,0). SpawnMeshesToWorld (:192,:207) selects meshes whose name ends with '_Tile_<i>_<j>'. The imported Ingolstadt grid is X in {6..10}, Y in {6..9}: 20 tiles, 5711 assets, and NO tile at (0,0). At (0,0) zero meshes match, ok is false, i is still 0, and the outer loop exits immediately having saved zero tile worlds.
not_yet_observed: The static proof is deterministic given the tile set, but PrepareAssetsForCooking has not yet been observed to run on this import. Confirmation requires the single-tile reproduction, which requires the UE binaries to be free.
